slides.headline: SC01: The Microscopic Weave
slides.narrative_copy: Extreme macro view of the interlocking cyan and carbon weave in complete stillness. -> At second 03, tension applies and individual yarn microfibers stretch taut with visible physical elongation. -> Laser line sweeps across the weave, highlighting microscopic fiber textures. Kinetic Chain: Relaxed fibers -> Tensile load applied -> Yarn elongation under force -> Surface micro-flattening -> Stable high-tension lock.

slides.headline: SC02: The Airflow Ignition
slides.narrative_copy: Camera pulls back to a medium shot as wind tunnel nozzles ignite with high-speed laminar airflow. -> White condensation streamlines wrap smoothly over the taut fabric sheet with zero turbulence. -> The fabric ripples rhythmically with high-frequency aerodynamic waves. Kinetic Chain: Nozzle airflow discharge -> Air pressure boundary layer forms -> Fluid-structure interaction on fabric -> Aerodynamic ripple wave propagation -> Stable laminar wave state.

slides.headline: SC03: The Aerodynamic Deflection
slides.narrative_copy: Camera tracks laterally around the fabric as it flexes into an aerodynamic winglet curve. -> Laser illumination reveals vortices rolling smoothly off the trailing edge. -> The material maintains rigid structural integrity under maximum velocity. Kinetic Chain: Peak wind velocity -> Aerodynamic lift force generates deflection -> Flexible composite arm reaches planned bend angle -> Trailing edge sheds micro-vortex -> Dynamic equilibrium under load.

slides.headline: SC04: The Deceleration & The Form Lock
slides.narrative_copy: Wind tunnel airflow suddenly cuts off with a deep pneumatic thud. -> The fabric springs back into its pristine planar resting position with a satisfying tactile snap. -> Laser illumination freezes on the pristine weave as smoke gently dissipates into stillness. Kinetic Chain: Airflow cutoff -> Pressure drop -> Elastic restoring force snaps fabric -> Momentum damping oscillation -> Absolute static resting state.
